title: Country tiers
description: One entry per ISO 3166-1 country code (plus XK for Kosovo) with its advertising tier, World Bank income group and region, and EU/EEA flags.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. XK (Kosovo) is a user-assigned code, see iso_status.

numeric.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric code as a zero-padded string. Null for XK.

name.description: English short name as published in Debian iso-codes.

common_name.description: Common English name where iso-codes has one (South Korea, Vietnam), otherwise the short name.

tier.description: Advertising tier. An industry convention, not an official classification.

tier_basis.description: named: listed in the reference article. rule: placed by the rule in sources/tiers.json.

alt_tiers.description: Other tiers some networks commonly use for this country.

income_group.description: World Bank income group. Null when the World Bank does not classify the economy.

region_code.description: World Bank region id, for example ECS or SSF.

eu_member.description: One of the 27 EU member states.

eu_territory.description: EU member state, or an area with its own ISO code that is part of the EU through a member state (outermost regions, Åland).

eea_member.description: EU member state, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Norway.
